title: Key Fob Services
excerpt: Help with key fob access, replacement, and programming-related needs.
intro: Planetlocksmiths provides mobile support for key fob-related automotive access and replacement needs across Philadelphia.

sections.heading: Fob-related access issues
sections.body: If a fob is missing, damaged, or not communicating with the vehicle, share the vehicle details before dispatch.

sections.heading: Replacement coordination
sections.body: Fob service may involve replacement, programming, or both depending on the vehicle and available parts.

faq.question: Can you help if my fob stopped working?
faq.answer: Yes. Fob-related access and replacement needs are supported for many vehicles.

faq.question: Do you stock every fob?
faq.answer: Availability depends on the vehicle and part. Dispatch will confirm what can be supported.
